data.content_ref: inline:The isolated block abstracts the CRT lattice structure (solution class 35k+18) from SRC_002, generalizing the single-step algebraic solution into a universal residue-class framework for coprime-modulus CRT problems. It is refuted if the CRT combination does not produce a unique residue class modulo 35 for coprime moduli 5 and 7, or if the general solution n≡18 mod 35 fails to enumerate all solutions including 18, 53, 88, ...
